evidence.detail: The class directly extends R436 CustomInterfaceBuilder and is constructed by R436 CustomInterfaceRegistry as part of the live custom-interface catalogue.
Its build method does not create a new root interface; it looks up existing widgets 29998, 29997 and 29994 and attaches exactly one new child to each.
The three inserted children use exact resources 'gameframe/info/sprite 2', 'gameframe/info/sprite 3' and 'gameframe/info/sprite 4', with child ids 65747, 65746 and 65745 respectively.
Each inserted sprite is placed at the same fixed child coordinates x=18, y=12 on its corresponding existing widget.
No surviving exact-v308 literal or caller proves a narrower product feature name for widgets 29994/29997/29998, so the recovery stops at the observable gameframe-info sprite patch behavior.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 behavior name for a CustomInterfaceBuilder that patches three existing gameframe-info widgets with sprites; no historical screen noun is claimed.
